title: MotionTransformer: Transferring Neural Inertial Tracking between Domains
source_status: No official network source verified in bounded publisher, author-project and exact-title repository searches; unrelated MTR/forecasting repositories are not sources
fidelity: independent paper-only sequence-GAN reconstruction with declared architecture, reduction and optimizer-stage assumptions

paper_contract.domains: labelled source train plus unpaired unlabelled target train
paper_contract.target_labels: evaluation_only; absent from all train APIs

equation_map.5: shared decoder, unit normal latent noise and domain vector
equation_map.8_9: two discriminators and printed minimax GAN objective
equation_map.11: source labels on source and source-translated-to-target predictions

unreported_assumptions: one-layer unidirectional LSTMs with hidden128 and linear readouts
sum norm across non-batch coordinates then mean over batch
one discriminator step then one joint generator step; optimizer and warm-up unknown

adaptation_contract.horizontal_labels: horizontal speed plus absolute world velocity direction, replacing original displacement/increment labels
adaptation_contract.vertical: separate learned vertical velocity; no zero padding
adaptation_contract.xy_rule: same XYZ[..., :2] for an XYZ run; dedicated 2D run remains separate

integration_blockers: single-labelled-batch Trainer has no reviewed unpaired target-train loader contract
Trainer needs disjoint two-optimizer stage and checkpoint/resume sampler-RNG support
paper body-frame polar target and stateful heading integration need separate native task protocol
validation loss policy must be explicit without introducing target labels into adaptation
